title: core.text.tracked-changes — the table of tracked changes
description: The tracked changes of the document (the application's change-tracking feature): one entry per (kind, author, date). Text and formatting refer to an entry by its `id` (`ins`, `del`, a formatting change's `rev`). THESE ARE DOCUMENT CONTENT. They are not the saved versions of the file: those are the werk revisions (spec/CRAFT-BASE.md section 3), which every Save appends and which no payload refers to. spec/PROFILE-RICH-DOCUMENT.md sections 3 and 4.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

changes.description: The tracked changes. `id`s are 0, 1, 2 … in array order.

items.description: One tracked change: who made it, when, and of what kind. (A tracked change is document CONTENT made with the application's change-tracking feature. It is not a saved version of the file; those are the werk revisions of `spec/CRAFT-BASE.md` section 3.)

id.description: The entry's number: its index in this array (the first entry is 0). Stated explicitly so that a reference never has to be counted.

author.description: Name of the person who made the change.

date.description: When the change was made, ISO 8601 (`2026-03-01T10:15:00Z`); may be empty.

move_name.description: For one end of a tracked MOVE: the name that links the source (an entry of kind `delete`) with the destination (an entry of kind `insert`). Null or absent: a plain insertion, deletion or formatting change.

RevisionKind.description: The kind of a tracked change. Values: `insert`: text or objects were inserted; `delete`: text or objects were deleted (they are still stored, marked as deleted); `format`: formatting was changed.
